profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Syniti
profile.summary:
Currently, I am working in the areas of Data Migration and Data Governance.  Both areas require a wide range of technical knowledge in order to extract, gather and process data from disparate systems.  My current goal is to learn more about the business processes that rely on the data, both through working with the people that use the data and by working with the data itself.

Previous positions I've worked on involved UNIX and NT system monitoring and administration, disaster recovery planning and testing, system backups and tape handling, routine diesel backup-generator testing, and IBM MQSeries administration (now called IBM Websphere MQ).  I have a strong background in one-on-one technical support.  I believe there are two goals in any problem resolution.  First to fix the problem, then to fix the cause of the problem.

Specialties: MS-SQL, Windows Server Administration, Shell Scripting, UNIX Administration, System Troubleshooting, MQ-Series Administration, Candle System Monitoring, IIS Administration, Web-Based Research
